title: Ferdinand magazine - EB Motorsport flat fan kit for air-cooled Porsche flat-six engines
notes: Reports EB Motorsport's flat fan kit, with a drive reverse-engineered from the 935 (shaft, rubber coupling, right-angle gearbox) and a carbon test fan. Measured fan power: 1.5 hp at 4,000 fan rpm and 32 hp at 12,000 fan rpm, roughly 8,000 engine rpm. Claims better cooling of cylinders 1 and 4 than an upright fan. No diameter, blade count, airflow or temperature data are published.
